name: hono-repo-pds
description: The PDS DenoPod of an application: one repo whose key is in the application's OpenBao, served on port 0 and on the did-key-ingress-proxy subdomain of its key, with the application's AtprotoRecord objects reconciled into it

market-identity-name.description: MarketIdentity object whose spec names the repo key's vault path and decides an association

associate-service-id.description: DID document service id of the association endpoint and the service of the association record

kcp-server.description: kcp server holding the MarketIdentity and AtprotoRecord objects

kcp-workspace.description: kcp workspace holding the MarketIdentity and AtprotoRecord objects

kcp-token-file.description: File holding the bearer token for the kcp server, re-read on every call

kcp-ca-cert-file.description: PEM CA bundle the kcp server's certificate chains to

vault-openbao-server.description: Name of the OpenBaoServer object that holds the repo key

vault-openbao-client.description: Client of that OpenBaoServer the PDS logs in as

vault-openbao-client-dir.description: Directory holding that client's certificate, key and the vault CA, kept current by the DenoPod's projected credentials

vault-kv-mount-client.description: Client of the OpenBaoServer whose kv mount holds the keys (the PDS client itself has no mount, only a read policy on the key path)

vault-kcp-server.description: kcp server URL (a /clusters/<workspace> URL) holding the OpenBaoServer object

vault-mount.description: KV mount the MarketIdentity's keys live under

storage-path.description: Deno KV file of the repo

plc-directory-url.description: PLC directory the repo's did:plc is registered in

ingress-proxy-host.description: did-key-ingress-proxy host; the repo is public on the subdomain of its key

network-hosts.description: Comma-separated name=address pairs of the market network's service names and the loopback address each answers on

port-file.description: File the bound TCP port is written to once listening

listeners-file.description: File every bound listener is reported to as JSON once listening

status-file.description: File the repo's DID and ingress host are written to as JSON once it is ready

memory-log-ms.description: How often the pds logs its process memory (pds_memory)
